question: Can a confidence-selective cascade recover the two fresh-target positive bindings rejected by universal corroboration while preserving all three exact-target-absent rejections and requesting specialist corroboration only for ambiguous local bindings?

decision_rule.base_requirement: The inherited bilateral local binding must commit; otherwise reject without requesting another branch.
decision_rule.direct_exit: If the inherited primary local all-cycle fraction is at least 0.25, commit directly.
decision_rule.ambiguous_branch: If local binding commits below 0.25, request the inherited complementary corroborator and commit only when global epipolar majority or bidirectional active-query majority supports it.
decision_rule.threshold_origin: One structural quarter-coverage landmark selected after observing the partial-confirmation failure. No grid, threshold sweep or best-of-many selection is permitted. Because the target-disjoint panel was already observed, this is Development only and requires another frozen source before any confirmation claim.

literature_motivation.paper: When Does Confidence-Based Cascade Deferral Suffice?
literature_motivation.used_principle: Inference cost should vary by sample and specialist downstream models should be invoked through a deferral rule rather than imposed as a universal gate; specialist and distribution-shift failure modes require validating the cascade on held-out data.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the 0.25 direct-exit threshold, Boolean composition, inherited pair, label or receipt
run a threshold sweep or select another threshold after viewing this recomposition
re-run, tune or repair any predecessor model result
count a local non-commit as a corroboration request or let corroboration override a local non-commit
claim success on these consumed panels as fresh confirmation or arbitrary sibling-door generalization
